name: ero-scrap
description: Monitoramento privado de mídia, armazenamento autorizado e catálogo temporário via GitHub Actions e Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.db:local:apply: npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 d1 migrations apply ero-scrap-db --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:remote:apply: npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 d1 migrations apply ero-scrap-db --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.r2:create: npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 r2 bucket create ero-scrap-thumbnails --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:web: npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 pages deploy apps/web/public --project-name ero-scrap --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check:pages: npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 pages functions build functions --project-directory . --outdir .wrangler/pages-functions-build
scripts.dev:pages: npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 pages dev apps/web/public --port 8788 --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:remote:apply:pages: npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 d1 migrations apply ero-scrap-db --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
